headline: Amazon reports 39% AWS growth and sharply higher Bedrock usage in Q3
summary: Amazon’s October 29, 2026 Q3 release reports AWS net sales of $46.0 billion, up 39% year over year, and AWS operating income of $17.8 billion. The company also reports Fortune 500 spending on Bedrock nearly 7x higher and Bedrock token volume nearly 17x higher year over year, while AgentCore was used by tens of thousands of customers who deployed twice as many agents in Q3 as in the prior three quarters combined. Amazon says its trailing-twelve-month free-cash-flow outflow was $42.4 billion, primarily reflecting a $94.8 billion year-over-year increase in net property and equipment purchases that primarily reflects AI investment. These are company-reported metrics. The release gives no AI-specific revenue, margin, utilization, token baseline or unit economics, so it does not establish that AI drove AWS growth or was profitable.
